Network Management and Orchestration System
The RADview Network Management and Orchestration suite offers service providers and critical
infrastructure operators a comprehensive solution to operate and manage Ethernet and broadband
access networks, switches and routers, virtualized network elements, multi-service gateways, and other
devices in the RAD solution portfolio.
Service Pack 7.2.3 v6e is a minor (maintenance) version released for General Availability. This version
includes 2 new features and 4 solved limitations.
Products and Components in Service Pack 7.2.3 v6e
Product/Component
Description
Manages RAD’s pCPE-OS using SNMP/SSH/SFTP South Bound
interfaces.
Domain Orchestrator
Manages RAD’s D-NFV platforms to create, configure and manage
virtual machines on the X.86 D-NFV module within customer edge
devices such as ETX-2 devices that are equipped with the X.86
processor. This functionality includes management of RAD-
certified VF (virtual function) applications such as routers,
cryptography, firewalls etc. and handles the traffic flow between
physical ports and a virtual switch.

Upgrading to Service Pack 7.2.3 v6e

title: upgrade notes
body:
Service packs are installed over the existing RADview installation. Before installing the service pack, it is
recommended to back up the RADview map and database using the backup utility.
 To install the service pack over RADview (Windows):
Extract the archive rv723-v6e.zip to a local folder of your choice.
1.
Install the service pack by double-clicking rvupdate.exe.
2.
The RADview patch is installed and the RADview server is restarted.
 To install the service pack over RADview (Linux):
Log in as superuser. If you operate your Linux station via Xlaunch from a PC, make sure to
1.
display GUI applications.
Extract the archive rv723-v6e.zip to a local folder of your choice.
2.
3.
Install the service pack by executing the following commands:
#chmod u+x rvupdate
#./rvupdate

title: System Fixed an issue where expired sessions were not cleared, causing users to be denied login with a 'Number of active clients exceeded' error.
body:
System
Fixed an issue where expired sessions were not cleared, causing users to be
denied login with a 'Number of active clients exceeded' error.
